lineage.description: Energy facility locations and types were mapped by CENACARTA through direct observational data collection and cartographic survey at 1:250,000 scale as part of a thematic national mapping project. The dataset provides a spatial inventory of infrastructure assets relevant to disaster risk assessment in Mozambique.
